main_text.p: נִיר m. Motus, Commotio, Job.16.5. Fœm. לְנִידָה In agitationem, Thr.1.8. ut Ab.Esra & R.Levi interpretantur. Quidam, In separatam ex immunditia, quasi idem quod לְנִדָּה, quod est v.17. ibid.
נֵר masc. Acervus, Cumulus, sic dictus, quòd Motu & Agitatione comportetur, Exod.15.8. כְּנֵד Quasi cumulum, Psal.33.7.
מָנוֹר m. Agitatio, Commotio: Constr. מְנַד רֹאשׁ Agitationem capitis, Psal.44.15.

נוּחַ Inhabitavit, In habitaculo mansit: Futur. וְלֹא יָנוּחַ Neq, in habitaculo permanet, Quietus resìdet, Habac.2.5. Hiph. Futur. וַאֲנוּחוּ Et habitare faciam eum, Habitaculum constituam ei, Exod.15.2. Chaldaeus: Exstruam ei sanctuarium: R.Salom. Enarrabo pulchritudinem & laudem ejus, à נוֹי Pulchritudo, נָוָה Pulcher, ut suprà in נאָה.
נָוָה f. Habitatio, Habitatrix: Constr. נוֹת צֶדֶק Habitationem justitiae tua, Job.8.6. וּנְוֹת בַּיִת Et habitatrix domus, Psal.68.13. Vide suprà in נאה.

נָוֶה m. Habitaculum, Jesa.27.10. Caula, Pascuum: quia ibi Caula fieri solent: Vide & suprà in נאה. Constr. נְוֵה Exod.15.13. Aff. אֶל נָוֵהוּ Ad caulam suam, Jer.10.19. Plural. נְוֵיהֶם Habitacula eorum, Jer.49.20. Et fœm. נוֹת Caula, Soph.2.6. Et ו in א commutato, נָאוֹת Idem, Psal.65.13. בִּנְאוֹת דֶּשֶׁא In caulis herba, id est, herbidis, Psal.23.2. E contrario supra in נאה convertitur א in ו. Vide illic.

נוּחַ Quievit, Requievit, Quietè se continuit, Resedit: Praeter. וְלֹא נָחָתִי Et non quievi, Job.3.26.&c. Hiph. הֵנִיחַ Quiescere, Requiescere fecit, Requiem, Quietem attulit, dedit vel largitus est. Constructur

page.notes: Headword of the large entry and of the last entry read as נוּחַ; the large entry is partly obscured. "Pul her" at the line break is printed with a gap, read as Pulcher. Several Hebrew construct forms (נְוֵה, נוֹת צֶדֶק, נְוֵיהֶם) are copied as far as legible but are not certain. The final word "Constructur" is cut at the right margin; the last letters are not clear. No catchword is printed.
